name: @opencraw/studio
description: OpenCraw Studio: a local server and React UI for opening a recipe folder, running samples and reading the trace next to the page the engine fetched.

scripts.prepack: node -e "const {execFileSync}=require('node:child_process');const {existsSync}=require('node:fs');const built=()=>existsSync('dist/ui/index.html');if(!built()){console.log('@opencraw/studio: building @opencraw/studio-ui (apps/studio-ui/vite.config.mts writes straight into dist/ui) before packing...');execFileSync('npx',['nx','run','@opencraw/studio-ui:build','--skip-nx-cache'],{cwd:'../..',stdio:'inherit'})}if(!built())throw new Error('dist/ui/index.html is still missing after building @opencraw/studio-ui: this package would ship a server with nothing to serve. See docs/research/recipe-studio.md.')"

options.command: vite build -c ../../apps/studio-ui/vite.config.mts && tsc -p tsconfig.e2e.json && jest --config jest.e2e.config.cts
